user.title: Connect SMPLwise Dry Contact
user.description: Enter the IP and select a model, or use auto for M31-U discovery. DI/AI/PT100 appear as sensors; DO/AO as controls. For older M31, list expansion card models in bus order in the advanced fields. Defaults: port 502, Modbus unit 1.

data.input_count: DI count override only (0 = model inventory)
data.expansion_models: Expansion card models in order (exclude internal card)

reconfigure.title: Change controller connection
reconfigure.description: Enter the new connection details for the same controller. Existing entity IDs are preserved.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot read the controller. Check the IP, port, Modbus address, TCP server mode, Modbus TCP protocol and IO bus health. For older M31 controllers, select the exact model instead of auto.
error.invalid_host: Enter a valid IP address, without http:// or a port.
error.unsupported_model: Cannot identify the model or IO inventory. Select a supported host and verify expansion card models and series.
error.model_required: This firmware does not provide a usable model register. Select the M31 model printed on the controller.
error.invalid_expansions: Invalid expansion inventory. Enter matching M31-G card models, comma-separated, in bus order.

abort.wrong_device: This IP belongs to a different controller (MAC address mismatch).

init.title: IO and expansion options
init.description: For manual expansion layout, list external card models in physical bus order, comma-separated, excluding the internal card. Example: GXXAX0080, GXAXX0800. An empty list uses M31-U discovery or the older M31 host alone. DI override affects digital inputs only. Inverted DI inputs are comma-separated numbers, for example 1, 3.

data.input_count: DI count override only (0 = model inventory)
data.expansion_models: Expansion card models in order (exclude internal card)

error.cannot_connect: Cannot read the controller. Check the connection and IO bus health.
error.unsupported_model: Cannot identify the model or IO inventory. Select a supported host and verify expansion card models and series.
error.invalid_inputs: Use comma-separated input numbers between 1 and the total detected input count.
error.invalid_expansions: Invalid expansion inventory. Enter matching M31-G card models, comma-separated, in bus order.
